jobs.title: Java Developer Mid to Senior
jobs.description: NCS Philippines is seeking passionate and skilled Java Developers (Mid-Level & Senior) to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade, cloud-native microservices for regional clients across Singapore, Southeast Asia, and Australia. Embedded in high-performing Agile teams, you will champion clean code, robust API architecture, containerized workloads, and DevSecOps best practices to power critical digital transformation initiatives. • Develop high-performance RESTful microservices using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot. • Translate user stories and technical specs into clean, modular, and maintainable code. • Integrate data access layers with Hibernate/JPA and relational/NoSQL databases. • Implement OpenAPI/Swagger-documented endpoints, JSON/XML payloads, and token authentication. • Integrate with 3rd-party services, enterprise message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and frontend apps. • Build Docker container images and deploy workloads to Kubernetes/OpenShift. • Utilize GitLab CI/GitHub Actions/Jenkins for automated pipeline runs and environment verification.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant
jobs.description: Job Description The Accounts Payable Accountant verifies, and records invoices, manages vendor records, ensures financial compliance, resolves discrepancies, and supports smooth operations while assisting vendors and other departments. Principal Tasks: The Accounts Payable Accountant is responsible for processing invoices, managing vendor records, reconciling accounts, ensuring timely payments, maintaining compliance with financial policies, and supporting reporting and audit requirements. Main Tasks: Manage the company inboxes, and follow up with vendors if invoices and/or onboarding forms are incorrectly submitted, ensuring compliance with company internal control requirements. Manage vendor requests, reminders, and inquiries, and follow up on outstanding vendor invoices. Reconcile supplier statements of accounts in IFS, investigating and resolving any discrepancies or issues. Timely uploading and scanning of FDA, ADMIN, and OPEX invoices into Tungsten AP Essentials, along with uploading FDA Excel template into IFS. Ensure accurate and timely processing of invoices for FDA, ADMIN, and OPEX, verifying approvals, coding expenses correctly, and maintaining compliance with company policies. Compile and upload supporting documents related to logistics partners, including Marintrans and DSV, ensuring completeness and proper documentation. Sending weekly follow-up or reminders to approvers for outstanding invoices or tasks that require their attention in IFS. Regularly update monitoring of disputed or on-hold invoices in the system, ensuring accurate tracking and reporting for accrual. Prepare and submit monthly invoice reports for LJAM and HCOL (e.g., PWC) for local compliance requirements. Update and send the weekly ATPI flight coding template to Crew Managers for cost allocation and upload the updated template to IFS on time.
